task_description: Build 50 static HTML image templates for Instagram posts (1080x1080) following the HyperFrame static image engine contract. Each template is a self-contained package with manifest.json, layout-1x1.html, assets/, thumb.png, and BUILD-NOTES.md. After all 50, generate registry.json, BATCH-REPORT.md, and ZIP.

verification.summary: All 50 templates built with valid JSON manifests, proper HTML structure, CSS variables for theming, data-slot/data-role/data-importance attributes. Registry.json lists all 50. BATCH-REPORT.md exists. templates.zip (218K) created. No JavaScript found. STATUS.json confirms 50/50 completed.
